spec.name: M6.EuclidStorage.rem_loop_refines
spec.statement: ∀ (fuel : ℕ) (s : M6.EuclidStorage.Slots) (c t : ℕ), let r := M6.EuclidStorage.remLoop fuel s c t; r.slots.p = s.p ∧ r.slots.q = s.q ∧ r.slots.saved = s.saved ∧ r.slots.work = (M6.Euclid.remainderAux fuel s.work s.q).value ∧ r.cancellations = c + (M6.Euclid.remainderAux fuel s.work s.q).cancellations ∧ r.rounds = 0 ∧ r.passes = t + (M6.Euclid.remainderAux fuel s.work s.q).passes
spec.guidance: Induct fuel generalizing s c t. The actual tail call increments its accumulators before overwriting only work. Split the common remainder stopping guard, instantiate induction with updated slot record, and combine its projection equalities by arithmetic. Keep source algorithm intact. Return only tactic proof lines without leading by. Keep frozen target and default limits.

spec.name: M6.EuclidStorage.gcd_loop_refines
spec.statement: ∀ (fuel : ℕ) (s : M6.EuclidStorage.Slots) (c e t : ℕ), s.work = 0 → let r := M6.EuclidStorage.gcdLoop fuel s c e t; r.slots.saved = s.saved ∧ r.slots.work = 0 ∧ M6.EuclidStorage.toRun r = M6.EuclidStorage.offset (M6.Euclid.euclidAux fuel s.p s.q) c e t
spec.guidance: Induct fuel generalizing s and accumulators. q0 and fuel0 return directly. In the other branch apply rem_loop_refines at rank s.p to slots(0,q,p,saved), with c0,t1, matching the complete remainder call. Its q and saved slots are preserved. Apply induction to slots(q,remainder,0,saved), then normalize offset counters. Equality of Run records follows their four field equalities (cases/ext), not an oracle assumption. Return only tactic proof lines without leading by. Keep frozen target and default limits.

spec.guidance: Instantiate gcd_loop_refines at rankq+1 with slots(p,q,0,saved), initial passes t+1. Unfold only gcdStart, euclid and offset as needed. The initial fuel degree scan is included in both counters. Return only tactic proof lines without leading by. Keep frozen target and default limits.

spec.name: M6.EuclidStorage.preprocess_refines
spec.statement: ∀ a b M : M6.Euclid.BP, M6.EuclidStorage.toRun (M6.EuclidStorage.preprocess a b M) = M6.Euclid.preprocess a b M
spec.guidance: Use gcd_start_refines twice. First start has zero accumulators and preserves saved=M; extract its p/value and all counters from toRun equality. Second start reuses the same slots with p=first result,q=M,saved0 and initial accumulators from first run. Match the original shared two-call preprocessing record by fields. No recursive array-frame storage is used in this tail-machine algorithm. Return only tactic proof lines without leading by. Keep frozen target and default limits.

spec.name: M6.EuclidStorage.rem_loop_safe
spec.statement: ∀ (fuel : ℕ) (s : M6.EuclidStorage.Slots) (c t width : ℕ), 0 < width → M6.EuclidStorage.slotsFit width s → fuel ≤ 32*width → c + (M6.Euclid.remainderAux fuel s.work s.q).cancellations ≤ 32*width → t + (M6.Euclid.remainderAux fuel s.work s.q).passes ≤ 32*width → M6.EuclidStorage.remSafe fuel s c t width
spec.guidance: Induct fuel with s/c/t generalized. The supplied remaining-run budgets bound all current and terminal counters. In a cancellation branch, accepted Euclid.cancel_drop preserves work width; unfold one remainderAux step in the budgets to obtain the recursive c+1,t+2 budgets. The other three polynomial slots remain unchanged. No final-budget assumption remains in the actual preprocess theorem. Return only tactic proof lines without leading by. Keep frozen target and default limits.

spec.statement: ∀ (fuel : ℕ) (s : M6.EuclidStorage.Slots) (c e t width : ℕ), 0 < width → M6.EuclidStorage.slotsFit width s → s.work = 0 → fuel ≤ 32*width → c + (M6.Euclid.euclidAux fuel s.p s.q).cancellations ≤ 32*width → e + (M6.Euclid.euclidAux fuel s.p s.q).rounds ≤ 32*width → t + (M6.Euclid.euclidAux fuel s.p s.q).passes ≤ 32*width → M6.EuclidStorage.gcdSafe fuel s c e t width

For nonzeroq, use accepted remainder_aux_correct/remainder_passes at rankp to bound the inner local counters by rankp and2rankp+2≤32width; prove its remSafe via rem_loop_safe. rem_loop_refines identifies its preserved q/saved and actual remainder value/counters. remainder_correct preserves width. Unfold one euclidAux step in remaining budgets, rewrite inner result fields, and apply induction at the tail state. The fixed layout retains M and overwrites work. spec.name: M6.EuclidStorage.gcd_start_safe
spec.statement: ∀ (p q saved : M6.Euclid.BP) (c e t width : ℕ), 0 < width → M6.Euclid.rank p ≤ width → M6.Euclid.rank q ≤ width → M6.Euclid.rank saved ≤ width → c + (M6.Euclid.euclid p q).cancellations ≤ 32*width → e + (M6.Euclid.euclid p q).rounds ≤ 32*width → t + (M6.Euclid.euclid p q).passes ≤ 32*width → M6.EuclidStorage.gcdSafe (M6.Euclid.rank q+1) ⟨p,q,0,saved⟩ c e (t+1) width
spec.guidance: Apply gcd_loop_safe. rankq+1≤width+1≤32width since width positive; rankzero=0. Unfold euclid in the budget equalities to account for its extra initial pass. This reusable helper is instantiated without budget premises in preprocess_safe. Return only tactic proof lines without leading by. Keep frozen target and default limits.

spec.name: M6.EuclidStorage.preprocess_safe
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (a b M : M6.Euclid.BP), a.natDegree ≤ N → b.natDegree ≤ N → M.natDegree ≤ N → M6.EuclidStorage.preprocessSafe (N+1) a b M

First gcd_start_safe has zero accumulators. gcd_start_refines preserves M and identifies first output/counters; euclid_output_width bounds its result rank≤width. Second run starts with those first counters, so total budgets are≤4width,2width,18width, all≤32width. Apply gcd_start_safe again. This proves capacity for every actual recursive configuration of both calls. Return only tactic proof lines without leading by. Keep frozen target and default limits.

spec.name: M6.EuclidStorage.slots_encoding
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (s u : M6.EuclidStorage.Slots), M6.EuclidStorage.slotsFit (N+1) s → M6.EuclidStorage.slotsFit (N+1) u → M6.Euclid.dense N s.p = M6.Euclid.dense N u.p → M6.Euclid.dense N s.q = M6.Euclid.dense N u.q → M6.Euclid.dense N s.work = M6.Euclid.dense N u.work → M6.Euclid.dense N s.saved = M6.Euclid.dense N u.saved → s = u
spec.guidance: Apply accepted Euclid.dense_injective separately to each slot using slotsFit bounds, then prove the Slots records equal by their fields. Four binary arrays thus faithfully encode the complete polynomial store, including retained M. Return only tactic proof lines without leading by. Keep frozen target and default limits.
